# `fact.deprecate`

Reversibly supersede/disable a fact. Evidence remains.

- **group:** `mutation`
- **posture:** `reversible`
- **CLI:** `operator-voice fact-deprecate`
- **MCP tool:** `fact_deprecate` (mutation — hidden unless explicitly enabled)

## Arguments

| name | type | required | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fact_id` | `str` | required |  |
| `reason` | `str` | optional, default='' |  |

## Examples

```
operator-voice fact-deprecate --fact-id fact_abc123
```
